decisions.implementation: ExperimentalBladePort.SupportsTemporaryFullCharge admits 0x02C7 beside 0x02A0. Writes stay limited to 00/04 with the other shared bits clear, an admitted enabled charge limit for enablement, Windows-reported external power for enablement (ExternalUnknown counts, Battery refuses; cancellation needs no power), fresh exact-device admission, independent readback of the flag and the raw charge policy, and a write pause after any possibly submitted failure. 07/8F has not been observed on this model: a failed or undecodable read leaves the override unknown and blocks only override changes, while the limiter write, its confirmation and fan, performance and lighting recovery keep their previous behaviour. A positive override blocks the limiter, and so does an unreadable one that OpenBlade last decoded or confirmed as on; only a possibly submitted 07/0F write makes 07/8F a recovery prerequisite. Protection off with bit 04 set has no confirmed representation and is read as an unknown override. Bit 08 (localDimming) can also be set on this model and blocks the write the same way.

panel.result: Bit 08 (localDimming) can be latched on this model as well. Its device settings declare isLocalDimmingEnable, its Blade series is 11, and the shared policy writes bit 08 for series 10 to 12. Only the hasLocalDimming flag that makes Synapse follow Windows HDR automatically is absent. OpenBlade refuses the override while bit 08 is set and tells the user, if Synapse is running, to turn off Windows HDR, close Synapse, then retry.

decisions.ackContract: The existing 0x02C5 backend already uses the status-only SET acknowledgment contract (ExperimentalBladePort.UsesSourceBackedSetAckContract) for its other source-reviewed setters; the 709 helper parses payload only when packetSizeReturned > 0, so the 07/0F write accepts a status-only ACK and does not require an echo.
decisions.implementation: ExperimentalBladePort.SupportsTemporaryFullCharge admits 0x02C5 with the same safeguards as 0x02C7, including the same handling of an unreadable 07/8F. Products 709 and 711 can both set localDimming; any set 08 bit blocks the write, since the shared guard does not read-modify-write other bits, and no Clear action is offered for it here.
